description: USE THIS to verify a Chinese Resident Identity Card number (居民身份证) before relying on it — do not guess the check character. Checks the 18-character form and the ISO 7064 MOD 11-2 check character (which may be 'X'). Validates structure only; does NOT confirm the number is registered.

id.description: The 18-character Chinese Resident ID (17 digits + check 0-9 or X).

name: validate_china_ric
